meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定制Claude的记忆模式,让重要内容按场景自动记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望Claude按场景记住关键信息并提醒你
copy.tagline_en: Create custom memory modes so Claude tracks what matters by scenario
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Claude to remember key details per scenario and remind you

howto.what: 装上后，当你要求定制 claude-mem 的记忆时，它会先问你在做什么工作，再提议一套互相不重叠的笔记类型和可复用的标签；经你批准后安装自定义模式，可选配 Telegram 提醒，再重启并确认新设置生效。
howto.when: 当你要求定制 claude-mem 记住的内容、新建或修改模式、给某领域记笔记、增加笔记类型或标签，或为特定记忆发 Telegram 通知时——即使没说“mode”这个词。

say.text: 帮我给 claude-mem 做一个法学学习模式，专门记录判例规则和考试陷阱。
say.note: 它会先问你在学什么，再给出分类方案等你确认。

say.text: 以后把设计决策、代码约束和客户偏好都记进 claude-mem。
say.note: 它会先查现有模式，能复用相近模式就不重复新建。

howto.what_en: After installation, it interviews the user, proposes note types and tags, installs the approved mode, optionally adds Telegram alerts, and confirms the new settings are active.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks what claude-mem should remember, to create or change a mode, add note types or tags, or get Telegram alerts for selected memories, even without saying “mode.”

say_en.text: Make a law-study mode for claude-mem that records case rules and exam traps.
say_en.note: It interviews you before proposing a taxonomy.

say_en.text: Record design decisions, code constraints, and client preferences in claude-mem.
say_en.note: It checks installed modes and reuses a close match when possible.

say_en.text: Send a Telegram alert when claude-mem records a client-preference tag.
say_en.note: It asks which types or tags should trigger alerts.
